rationale.conceptual: An established but non‑trivial method (plane‑wave DFT) with several interacting components; constructing interface models and extracting correct HOMO/LUMO, interfacial energies, and bulk moduli requires understanding of slab theory, convergence, and elastic constant calculations.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves 5 stages with dependencies (structure acquisition, geometry optimisation, single‑point, slab/interface construction, strain calculations) and many individual DFT runs. Orchestration is non‑trivial due to the need for consistent parameters, interface model building, and handling multiple materials.
